answer: When an agent first forges its identity, it must submit a timestamped VDF proof whose output can only be revealed after a wall‑clock delay equal to one tide‑cycle (≈12 h); the VDF input includes a unique willow‑derived salt tied to the node’s hardware TPM, binding the proof to that physical device. The network verifies the elapsed time and the salt before granting voting rights, rejecting any proof that arrives early or lacks the correct willow seed.
